name: Pricewatcha
description: Pricewatcha turns public product URLs into structured price intelligence — current price, historical low / high / average, and price trend. Through the MCP connector, Claude can search the product catalog, submit a product URL for tracking, and read full price history. It works fully anonymously: no account, no API key. Coverage spans major marketplaces and long-tail shops via Pricewatcha's own crawler with a commercial-scraper fallback.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pricewatcha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pricewatcha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pricewatcha.com/.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pricewatcha MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricewatcha provides these MCP tools: get_api_status, search_products, get_product, get_price_history, track_product, and get_job_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pricewatcha?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pricewatcha in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Get My eSIM, and Is It Legit by M8ven.
Pricewatcha does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Pricewatcha is developed by Pricewatcha. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
